2026-10-31 03:30:40.505454 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505519 | controller |
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505543 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505557 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505567 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505577 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505582 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505708 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-31 03:30:40.505720 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
